name: Onix Fira
description: At Hotel Onix Fira, a comprehensive renovation has transformed all facilities, from the rooms to the common areas, resulting in a contemporary and avant-garde design that combines comfort, functionality, and style. This three-star hotel boasts a privileged location overlooking Parc Joan Miró and adjacent to Plaça Espanya. It's perfectly situated near major business venues, including the Palau de Congressos and Fira II de Barcelona, and offers excellent connections to the airport and the Fira Exhibition Centre. All spacious, bright rooms have been renovated with a modern and functional design, featuring a private bathroom, free Wi-Fi, a safe, a minibar, and a telephone. Guests can enjoy a seasonal rooftop swimming pool with unique city views and relax or work in the modern and cozy common areas. Discover our new gastronomic spot at the Hotel, El Quiosco: you can savour traditional tapas.
